question: In a region of crossed electric field $\vec{E}$ and magnetic field $\vec{B}$, a charged particle moves without deflection with velocity $\vec{v}$. If the speed of the particle is doubled ($2v$), in which direction will it deflect?

options.A: In the direction of the electric force
options.B: In the direction of the magnetic force
options.D: In a direction perpendicular to both forces
